_note: Pictures, video clips and 3D models Fuel offers, priced per output (provider cost in USD; Fuel adds its markup). Pictures are about 1 megapixel; clips are about 5-6 seconds; 3D models are GLB files made from a FLUX schnell picture (its cost is included). fal prices come from fal's pricing API (read 2026-11-26). Every fal request sends X-Fal-Store-IO: 0 and a 1-hour file expiry. Models with a 'partner' run on that company's own servers behind fal: fal's no-storage setting doesn't bind them, so Fuel shows a privacy warning for them. Together runs Wan 2.7 itself with prompt storage OFF. Sync: node --env-file=<env> scripts/sync-media-models.mjs [--dry] typical_seconds: how long a run usually takes (measured 2026-11-26), used for the studio's progress bar. Speech is priced per 1,000 characters; transcription per minute of audio (Whisper bills fal per compute second; 0.006/min is a conservative estimate from fal's 0.00111/compute-second). Uploaded audio goes to fal storage with the 1-hour expiry. quality: Draft < Good < High < Best (Fuel's judgement within each kind); speed is derived from typical_seconds.

image.blurb: FLUX schnell: fast drafts, a picture in a second or two. The cheapest way to try ideas.
Qwen-Image: good at text inside pictures and at following detailed prompts.
FLUX dev: sharp, detailed pictures with natural light.
Ideogram 3: posters, logos and anything with lettering.
Recraft 3: design work, illustrations and brand-style pictures.
FLUX 1.1 pro: finished pictures with real detail.

video.blurb: LTX Video: a short clip from one sentence, fast and the cheapest way to make video.
LTX Video 13B: sharper detail and steadier motion than LTX.
Wan 2.7: a 5-second clip with smooth motion and consistent scenes.
Hailuo-02: cinematic 6-second clips with strong physics.

mesh.blurb: TRELLIS: a textured 3D model (GLB) from a quick picture of your prompt.
Hunyuan3D 2: detailed, clean 3D models for games and scenes.

mesh_picture.note: 3D jobs first make this picture (cost included above: 0.0032)

speech.blurb: Kokoro: natural, clear voices for narration and assistants. The cheapest way to make speech.
ElevenLabs Turbo 2.5: expressive voices in 30+ languages with low delay.
MiniMax Speech-02 HD: studio-quality voices with rich emotion.

transcription.blurb: Whisper: accurate transcripts in 90+ languages from an audio file.
